SELECT sda.id, sda.classes, sda.attendance_date, sda.employee_name, sda.identity_card, sda.clock_in_date, sda.clock_out_date, sda.scheduled_hours, sda.actual_hours, sp.department, fpa.position_name as departmentName, sp.team, fwg.work_group_name as teamName FROM swm_daily_attendance sda LEFT JOIN swm_person sp ON sda.identity_card = sp.identity_card LEFT JOIN fms_position_archive fpa ON sp.department = fpa.id COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci LEFT JOIN fms_work_group fwg ON sp.team = fwg.id COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci WHERE sda.STATUS = 0 AND sp.STATUS = 0 AND sda.attendance_date >= #{startDate} AND sda.attendance_date <= #{endDate}

SELECT a.employee_name AS employeeName, pa.position_name AS departmentName, sp.job_type AS jobType, a.idle_hours AS idleHours, SUM(IFNULL(a.idle_hours, 0)) AS monthIdleHours FROM `swm_daily_attendance` a JOIN swm_person sp ON a.identity_card = sp.identity_card left JOIN fms_position_archive pa ON sp.department = pa.id COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci WHERE a.`status` = '0' AND sp.`status` = '0' AND sp.personnel_status = '1' AND a.attendance_date BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} GROUP BY sp.identity_card ORDER BY monthIdleHours DESC

SELECT t.employee_name AS employeeName, sp.phone_number AS phoneNumber, t.useHours, t.workDepartmentHours FROM ( SELECT identity_card, employee_name, SUM(IFNULL(idle_hours + effective_work_hours, 0)) AS useHours, SUM(IFNULL(effective_work_hours, 0)) AS workDepartmentHours FROM swm_daily_attendance WHERE status = '0' AND attendance_date BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} GROUP BY identity_card ) t JOIN swm_person sp ON t.identity_card = sp.identity_card WHERE sp.status = '0' AND sp.personnel_status = '1' AND sp.person_type = '1' ORDER BY t.workDepartmentHours DESC
